description: This file defines the interface ExternalServicesPropertiesReadPlatformService, which provides methods to access configuration data related to external services such as S3, SMTP, messaging gateways, and notifications within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ExternalServicesPropertiesReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for retrieving external service configuration data such as credentials, messaging, and notification configurations.

methods.name: getS3Credentials
methods.description: Retrieves the credentials required to access Amazon S3 storage.

methods.name: getSMTPCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves SMTP credentials for email services.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of external service properties filtered by service name.
